# Citation-shaped tokens that no residue pattern claims, one per line.
#
# TestNoNewUnclaimedCitationShapes fails when the tree gains a token of this
# shape that is not listed here. This file is a ceiling, not a baseline: an entry
# that stops occurring needs no edit, and neither does one that a widened pattern
# starts claiming. Adding an entry is the decision that needs a reason, and the
# only two reasons are below.

# Story and epic number references. Real residue under the naming rule, but a
# class of its own: none of these is a scenario ID, and no gate claims the class.
# The window this file gives onto it is narrow - the class runs to several hundred
# occurrences tree-wide - so clearing them is not driven from here.
